title: Packaging Repack Cutover: Readiness & Communications Checklist
creator: Sofia Morales
description: Coordination ticket to run the final readiness checklist and cross-team communications for the packaging and SKU repack cutover. Covers entitlements, quota limits, billing migration notes, docs, release notes packaging, and sales enablement assets. Goal: ensure zero-surprise cutover for current customers and clear post-cutover remediation paths.
goals: Finalize SKU-to-entitlement mapping and publish canonical mapping in Confluence
Lock migration cutover date and gating checklist with Eng/SRE/Billing
Publish customer-facing release notes and developer migration guide
Deliver sales enablement playbook and objection handling scripts
Coordinate billing cutoff and one-time credit runs for impacted accounts
comms_plan: Audience: Admins, Devs, Billing contacts, Sales
Channels: Release notes page, email to billing admins, Console banner, Changelog, In-product migration CTA
Timing: T-7 days detailed comms, T-1 day reminder, T+1 post-mortem and remediation steps
Owner: Aaron Feldman (Docs) for public notes, Mateo Diaz for billing notices
release_notes_tasks: Author: public release notes with impacted SKUs and migration steps
Include example mapping tables and common jq transforms for audit exports
Add a prominent FAQ section for quota/per-minute limits changes
Link to developer migration guide and support contact form
Coordinate with Console team to surface in-product CTA for affected customers
sales_enablement: Battle cards: top 6 objections with scripted answers and credit policy
Deck: migration benefits and timeline for AE use during renewal conversations
Slack channel: #pm-pricing-repack for real-time Q&A during cutover
billing_cutover: Sandbox verification: invoice and metering sanity checks completed 2026-03-12
Production dry-run: simulate credits and new SKU assignments for 50 pilot accounts
Backstop plan: rollback mapping and issue one-time credits within 24 hours if systemic billing errors detected
Audit artifacts: store mapping CSV and job logs in secure billing bucket
operational_gates: All PRs merged for billing transformation and console UX
SRE runbook updated and on-call rota assigned for cutover week
Monitoring dashboards created: unexpected revenue delta, failed migrations, quota-denied errors
Smoke test checklist sign-off by Eng and SRE
risks: High: Incorrect SKU mapping leading to overbilling or service denials
Medium: Late discovery of edge-case quotas for legacy accounts
Medium: Sales/AE misalignment resulting in churn during renewals
Low: Minor doc typos causing developer confusion
mitigation_plans: Wide pre-cutover audit of top 500 accounts by revenue and active usage
Holdback window for automated quota enforcement for 24 hours post-cutover
Automated reconciliation job to detect and queue suspected charge anomalies
Dedicated triage war room first 72 hours with reps from PM/Eng/Billing/Support
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SKU mapping published and approved by Billing and Legal
All communication artifacts approved and scheduled in the comms calendar
Billing test results pass acceptance thresholds in sandbox and pilot accounts
Support runbook exists with escalation paths and template credit grants
